messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> HIGH latency: eu-inference-queue (500+ms p50, 1xx p95) for customers in EU region. Auto-escalation to oncall.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident #PD-7421 created and routed to oncall policies (sre-eu). See https://pagerduty.example/PD-7421
jamal: acked
jamal: grabbing this. quick check — is it just latency or 5xxs?
alex: seeing elevated 429s on the embedding workers in eu-prod, clients report timeouts
maria: joining. @jamal can you paste recent logs? I want to see if KV cache thrash or autoscaler stuck.
jamal: tailing logs now, looks like steady queue depth spike when seq length > 1024
jamal: snippet:
```
2026-03-14T11:02:03Z inference-worker[pid=42] INFO backlog=312 p50=520ms p95=1210ms model=redwood-7b-v1
2026-03-14T11:02:05Z inference-worker[pid=42] WARN kv_cache_miss=0.87 batch_size=1
```
alex: batch sizes collapsing to 1 — clients not sending streaming prefetch; throughput tanking
maria: hypothesis: sudden customer burst + small seqs causing batching inefficiency. Quick mitigations: 1) enable routing fallback to a cheaper smaller-model pool to reduce latency, 2) spin up extra dedicated nodes in eu-dedicated pool, 3) enable prefix caching for top customers.
jamal: can we flip the routing policy without a deploy? what’s the command?
alex: you can flip in console but fastest is API call — partial example:
```
PATCH /v1/routing/policy/eu
{
  "policy": "latency-first",
  "fallback_model": "redwood-3b-quant-v2",
  "max_shift": 20
}
```
jamal: doing API call now
jamal: (runs) -> 200 OK. routing switch started, moving ~12% traffic to fallback
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook: Inference queue latency — steps executed: routing fallback enabled; scale up requested; create incident ticket PD-7421-ops
maria: I kicked off a scale on the dedicated pool: `kubectl scale deploy inference-eu --replicas=10 -n dedicated-eu` — scaling should add capacity in ~90s
jamal: pinging metrics — p50 down to 320ms, p95 down to ~600ms. Still elevated but improving :thumbsup:
alex: we should notify impacted customers with a short blurb. Maria, can you draft? I'll send from status page.
maria: Draft: "We're investigating increased latency for inference requests from EU. We're routing some traffic to alternate model variants and adding capacity. No data loss. We'll post updates in 30 minutes."
jamal: sent to status page
jamal: monitoring for regressions. keeping PD ticket assigned to me while we stabilize; will hand off to SRE rotation after 30m if stable
alex: reminder: create follow-up to evaluate batching heuristics and client SDK prefetch recommendations. Filed as INT-2467
sre-runbook-bot: Note added to PD-7421: mitigation steps executed and follow-ups created (INT-2467).
pagerduty-bot: PD-7421 status -> acknowledged by jamal; escalation paused.
maria: good job team. once p95 < 450ms for two consecutive 5m windows, we can close the page and hand to rotation.
jamal: agreed. will update in 10m.
alex: small ops tip: consider a temporary token-based rate-limit exception for high-volume enterprise customers to reduce client retries.
maria: logging that as a follow-up as well.
jamal: final ping — p95 420ms, p50 180ms, queue depth trending down. PD-7421 -> marking as resolved in 10m unless it re-fires.
jamal: resolved (manual) — closing PD-7421. Notes: routing fallback and +replicas worked as expected; follow-ups: INT-2467 (batching), INT-2468 (routing-compose tests), customer outreach log."
